epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 父親去世後,Nathan和妹妹回到祖家準備出售房子。在此期間,Nathan發現這處房產是從兩名曾被指控濫用巫術的女子的祖先手中偷來的。隨著他深入調查,揭開了一個與父親死亡相關的神秘陰謀,而這個陰謀如今..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their fathers death, Nathan and his sister return to their family home to prepare it for sale. While there, Nathan discovers that the land was stolen from the ancestors of two women accused of witchcraft. As he delves deeper, he uncovers an occult conspiracy linked to their fathers death which now threatens them both.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一個沿海小鎮,Rico與Sisca發展了一段不可能的戀情,卻因他們相愛而引發惡靈的出現。隨著整個城鎮發生連串駭人聽聞的死亡事件,也揭露了隱藏多年的秘密,使到整個城鎮被一股恐怖力量所控制。Rico必需..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位渴望成名的作家為了挽救低迷的事業,決心創作一部暢銷小說。他重返童年故居,這裡亦是其身為知名作家的父親當年神秘身亡之地。當他意外發現父親留下的最後手稿時,才驚覺這部作品遠超自己的才華。於是,他決定將..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A struggling writer retreats to his childhood home to finish a novel and save his career. There, he uncovers the final manuscript left behind by his father, a famous writer who died mysteriously years earlier. Realizing the work is beyond his own talent, he decides to plagiarize it, unleashing horrifying supernatural events.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽鬱香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.programme_title_tc: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2 (aka Offspring of the Devils Pact 2)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤兒Azlinda從小就受到鬼魂的困擾,相信這些折磨與父母的暗黑歷史密切相關。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz攜手合作,希望結束她的痛苦,但卻被一個邪惡的惡魔阻撓。Azlinda能否成功斬斷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王懷卿賣畫,為要籌藥費救患重病的妻子,途中意外遇上雀妖的追擊,幸得狐妖小容相救。為躲避雀妖,王懷卿將小容帶回家中,三人隨即陷入一場情感困局,而一段淒美的人妖虐戀亦隨即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

epg.programme_title_tc: Hide  Seek (aka The Last Hide  Seek)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十三年前,廢棄大廈的一場爆炸奪走了童的好友諾安。十三年後,童與昔日的朋友們重返故地,此地如今已成為他們就讀的大學校園。當一名與諾安容貌相同的女孩出現,兒時的遊戲化為索命的詛咒。復仇的惡靈再度甦醒,逐一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thirteen years after an explosion in an abandoned building killed their friend Noo Aon, Tong and his group return to the site—now their university campus. When a girl who looks exactly like Noo Aon appears, a childhood game turns into a lethal ritual. One by one, the friends are hunted by a vengeful spirit determined to settle a long-overdue score.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天臺舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幼女離奇失蹤後,悲痛的Drew與Helen在治療師安排下,前往偏遠林中小屋接受深度諮商。隨著孤立與壓抑逐漸侵蝕理智,療癒之旅化為噩夢。Helen飽受詭異幻象與異象困擾,逐漸分不清現實與幻覺,心智瀕臨崩..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their young daughter’s mysterious disappearance, Drew and Helen retreat to a secluded woodland cottage for therapy. As they struggle to salvage their marriage, isolation fractures their sanity. Haunted by visions and strange events, Helen can no longer tell what is real as her mind unravels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. However, they are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them, intending to find brides for her disabled grandsons. As they realise they have been captured, they must race against time to escape this nightmare island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個寧靜的晚上,一名患精神病的連環殺手擾亂了年輕夫婦的平淡生活。當這對夫婦為生存而戰時,他們隱藏多年的秘密亦隨之揭開,期間更意外地被牽連到黑社會的地下世界中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young couples tranquility is shattered by a psychotic serial killer one quiet evening. Their battle for survival reveals hidden truths, entangling them unwittingly with the criminal underworld.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 7 friends go on a road trip to a remote bungalow run by a village head and his daughter Suri. They host a party and ask Suri to help. Things spiral out of control and Suri is raped. Before killing herself, she curses them to be haunted in their dreams. As the friends are killed off one by one, they must break the curse to escape their deadly fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jennifer參加了一個探索荷蘭著名風車的旅行團。在途中,旅遊巴發生故障,迫使他們住進一所陰森的小屋,附近更有座可怕的風車。當部分團友突然離奇失蹤時,Jennifer發現他們之間隱藏著一個共同的秘密..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. As their tour coach breaks down on the way, they seek refuge in a creepy shed near a sinister windmill with a dark history. When some tour members suddenly disappear, Jennifer discovers a shared secret among them, linking their fates in a chilling revelation.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jass peaceful countryside getaway with her sister Laura is shattered when a group of drifters attacks them. After Laura is brutally killed, Jas discovers her lifeless body at their rented cabin. Consumed by grief and fury, she vows to hunt down the gang and take vengeance on her sisters murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Amy和養子Adrian逃離了虐待她的前女友Judith,躲在Amy堪薩斯家鄉的一棟廢棄農舍中,卻遭遇到因Amy的暗黑歷史所引發的邪惡超自然力量,讓Adrian感到恐懼。當Judith步步進逼時,Am..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amys Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 資深搖滾音樂唱片騎師Amy在擔任最後一次深宵節目主持期間,被一隻蝙蝠咬傷。一場暴風雨將Amy,她的神秘接班人和一位焦慮不安的工作人員困在小鎮的電台裡,在接近深宵時,情況變得更糟…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy gets bitten by a rabid bat during her last graveyard shift as a veteran punk rock disc jockey. When a storm traps Amy, her mysterious replacement and an anxious staff inside their small-town radio station, reality starts to distort as they go deeper into the graveyard shift…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次車禍後失憶的王人傑找到夜間警衛的工作。午夜,他準時抵達廢棄的大廈上班,卻發現三隻冤魂如約而至,並揭發了一場復仇計畫。究竟這是命運的安排還是邪靈的詛咒?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑米的妻子在車禍中不幸喪生的一年後,他游說妻子的妹妹與他一起返回事故現場,進行一場古怪的儀式。隨著夜幕低垂,傑米明顯有行兇的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year after Jamies wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潘辰是泰國一處偏僻的村莊裡受眾人敬仰和有名氣的靈媒。她希望她的姪女小普保有處女之身,以繼承她村內靈媒的地位。然而,當小普愛上青梅竹馬的圖恩後,靈界的秘密被揭開,他們的性命也面臨威脅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被譽為“屍語者的法醫秦明常可在屍體身上解剖出重要的線索。在調查一宗謀殺案時,秦明在實習助手和刑警隊長的協助下發現了塵封16年的雪山殺人案,同時亦揭發離奇謀殺案背後隱藏著的秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。凌晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天淩晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑米的妻子在車禍中不幸喪生的一年後,他游說妻子的妹妹與他一起返回事故現場,進行一場古怪的儀式。隨著夜幕低垂,傑米明顯有行兇的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year after Jamies wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑米的妻子在車禍中不幸喪生的一年後,他游說妻子的妹妹與他一起返回事故現場,進行一場古怪的儀式。隨著夜幕低垂,傑米明顯有行兇的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year after Jamies wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潘辰是泰國一處偏僻的村莊裡受眾人敬仰和有名氣的靈媒。她希望她的姪女小普保有處女之身,以繼承她村內靈媒的地位。然而,當小普愛上青梅竹馬的圖恩後,靈界的秘密被揭開,他們的性命也面臨威脅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被譽為“屍語者的法醫秦明常可在屍體身上解剖出重要的線索。在調查一宗謀殺案時,秦明在實習助手和刑警隊長的協助下發現了塵封16年的雪山殺人案,同時亦揭發離奇謀殺案背後隱藏著的秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。凌晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天淩晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 建築師May與男友Gun搬入新居後,驟聞繼母離奇身亡。May收留孤苦的繼妹Noon,怎料她入宅後竟行為詭異,頻遭惡靈附身,而May也陷入恐怖幻象與嚴重失眠的折磨。隨著宅內黑暗秘密逐步揭開,通靈法師終於..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After moving into a house with her boyfriend, Gun, architect May learns of her stepmother’s mysterious death. When May takes in her stepsister Noon, the girl begins showing signs of possession, while May suffers disturbing visions and insomnia. As dark secrets emerge, spiritual masters uncover an ancient black-magic curse hidden within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 攝影師陳志成長年被一名「紅衣女子」糾纏,導致多位親人慘死;甚至連自己心儀的女孩思桐亦難逃惡運。志成欲尋找思桐慘死的真相,卻揭發關於一場「冥婚」的秘密...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前水牛城女警Megan與友人到深山露營時,意外目睹當地警長以私刑處決毒販。事跡敗露後,警長為滅口,竟將他們列為追殺目標。眾人試圖逃離,卻發現所有下山路徑已被封死。為徹底掩蓋罪行,警長公然調動私人武裝民..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During a camping trip deep in the mountains, former Buffalo cop Megan and her friends stumble upon the local sheriff unlawfully executing a drug trafficker. Spotted and marked for death, they find every escape route sealed. To cover up his crime, the sheriff summons an armed militia to hunt them down—triggering a deadly chase with no way out.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕母親為女兒莫名失蹤而苦惱時,一連串怪異的事件接踵而至。這都可能與二十年前的意外亡魂為復仇歸來有關…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鍾馗收伏狐妖後回到河陽村,卻發現戀人芊芊與鄉親慘遭屠殺。為追查真兇,他下山前往陵都城尋找線索,途中邂逅因妖魔所害而化為半人半妖的琉璃公主。鍾馗揮舞降魔劍斬妖除魔,誓要拯救琉璃公主並守護城池安寧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hunting fox demons, Zhong Kui returns to Heyang Village only to discover that his lover and neighbours have been slaughtered. Following the trail to Lingdu City, he encounters Princess Liu Li, who has been cursed into a half-human, half-monster form. Armed with his demon-slaying sword, he battles the demons to save Liu Li and protect the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,富甲一方的康氏慘遭滅門,唯一的目擊證人—家中的幼女—在親眼目睹全家被殺後離奇失蹤。幾十年間,位於青木巷的廢棄康宅充斥著靈異驚悚的氣氛。隨著真相逐漸揭露,這個恐怖的疑團交織著復仇與死亡的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 五名大學生受委派前往一座神祕莊園進行專題研究,並結識了上流名媛莎拉吉夫人,卻發現她隱藏著致命祕密。隨著她的惡魔力量逐漸覺醒,原本的學術之旅瞬間化為生死逃亡,他們必須對抗統治階層延續數百年的詛咒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Five university students are assigned a project at a mysterious estate, where they meet Lady Salakjit, an elite socialite with a deadly secret. As her demonic powers surface, their academic trip turns into a frantic struggle for survival against a centuries-old curse of the ruling class.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. However, they are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them, intending to find brides for her disabled grandsons. As they realise they have been captured, they must race against time to escape this nightmare island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Olivia是位出色的吸血鬼言情小說作家,一直渴望遇到真正的吸血鬼。當吸血鬼Luke出現在Olivia位於雪地的偏僻小屋向她求助時,她的夢想終於成真。然而,當Luke的吸血鬼同伴在平安夜那天追捕他時,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Olivia, an outstanding vampire romance novelist, longs to encounter a real vampire. Her wish comes true when Luke turns up at her remote snowbound cabin seeking for help. However, her dream transforms into a chilling nightmare on Christmas Eve when Lukes vampire companions track him down...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,富甲一方的康氏慘遭滅門,唯一的目擊證人—家中的幼女—在親眼目睹全家被殺後離奇失蹤。幾十年間,位於青木巷的廢棄康宅充斥著靈異驚悚的氣氛。隨著真相逐漸揭露,這個恐怖的疑團交織著復仇與死亡的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一部反映喜劇演員舞臺上有歡樂,現實中有苦惱,家庭、事業有矛盾衝突,喜喜、悲悲,悲喜交融的故事片。
《尖刀班》的故事是以紅軍中的一個小隊作為故事的支點,以“直羅鎮戰役作為故事的依託,講訴了以趙奎,王富貴,孔夫子,秀秀等人為代表的紅軍戰士,如何在這次戰鬥中成長,犧牲的感人故事。
從小與父親疏遠的鄭輝,意外穿越回了八十年代,在與年輕時的父親一同經歷了許多事後,慢慢走進了陌生父親的內心,明白了工作之間並無尊卑之分,每個普通人都有著平凡而偉大的夢想。

《預備奶爸》故事大綱

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Patrick Bateman, a young man working on Wall Street at his fathers company kills for no reason at all. With each day, his hatred for the world becomes more and more intense. This incredibly dark comedy is based on the book by Bret Easton Ellis.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Matt Damon returns as Jason Bourne in Jason Bourne, with director Paul Greengrass back for another thrilling chapter. Bourne is drawn out of hiding, facing new dangers with Alicia Vikander, Vincent Cassel, and more.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Arnold Schwarzenegger reprises his career-changing role as the Terminator in this explosive film that was selected as one of AFI’s Top Ten Sci-Fi films of all time.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Citizens fighting for independence from Britain were met by an Army-quelled bloody riot that the government covered up. Over 100 Maltese were falsely jailed for instigating the violence.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2084, construction worker Douglas Quaid visits Rekall for a virtual Mars vacation—but the procedure unlocks hidden memories, thrusting him into a deadly rebellion and a secret-agent past.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 2084年,建築工人道格拉斯·奎德前往雷卡爾星球,進行一次虛擬的火星之旅——但這趟旅程卻意外喚醒被封存的記憶,將他捲入一場致命叛亂與特工身份的過去。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2084, construction worker Douglas Quaid visits Rekall for a virtual Mars vacation—but the procedure unlocks hidden memories, thrusting him into a deadly rebellion and a secret-agent past.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 2084年,建築工人道格拉斯·奎德前往雷卡爾星球,進行一次虛擬的火星之旅——但這趟旅程卻意外喚醒被封存的記憶,將他捲入一場致命叛亂與特工身份的過去。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2084, construction worker Douglas Quaid visits Rekall for a virtual Mars vacation—but the procedure unlocks hidden memories, thrusting him into a deadly rebellion and a secret-agent past.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 皮爾斯・布洛斯南主演《但丁峰》,一座寧靜小鎮面臨甦醒火山帶來的熔岩末日。爆炸性的動作場面與緊張懸疑,讓這部災難驚悚片成為必看之作!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pierce Brosnan stars in Dante’s Peak, where a quiet town faces fiery doom from a reawakening volcano. Explosive action and suspense make this disaster thriller a must-see ride!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位才華洋溢卻備受爭議的科學家,執著於打造具有人性智慧的機器,最終引發危險而不可預測的後果。這是一場科技與倫理的極限挑戰,也是一段關於人性與未來的深刻探討。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A brilliant but controversial research scientist becomes obsessed with his quest to create a humanistic machine, leading to a dangerous conclusion.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部電影取材自二戰真實事件,講述了一支美國潛艦小隊奉命捕捉一艘載有恩尼格瑪密碼機的德國U型潛艇的故事。一場充滿緊張、欺騙與生存挑戰的水下動作驚悚之戰即將展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Inspired by real WWII events, this film follows an American submarine crew tasked with capturing a German U-boat carrying the Enigma code machine. A tense, underwater action thriller full of deception, danger, and survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《 醉後末日》中,西蒙·佩格與尼克·弗羅斯特再次攜手展開史詩般的酒吧巡禮,卻意外捲入一場關乎人類未來的生死戰。導演埃德加·賴特(Edgar Wright)帶來充滿懷舊情懷、幽默喜劇與科幻刺激元素的獨特觀影體驗。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In The Worlds End, Simon Pegg and Nick Frost reunite for an epic pub crawl that turns into a fight for humanity’s future. Director Edgar Wright delivers a hilarious mix of nostalgia, comedy, and sci-fi thrills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《地獄怪客2:金甲軍團》中,地獄怪客必須迎戰一支由邪惡反派釋放出的致命怪物大軍。由吉勒摩・戴托羅執導,這部動作續集融合了幽默感、英雄氣概與史詩級的激烈戰鬥。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Hellboy 2: The Golden Army, Hellboy faces a deadly army of creatures unleashed by a sinister villain. Directed by Guillermo del Toro, this action-packed sequel blends humor, heroism, and epic battles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 麥特戴蒙回歸,再次飾演傑森伯恩,保羅葛林格拉斯執導的《神鬼認證:傑森包恩》也將繼續上演驚險刺激的續集。伯恩被迫重出江湖,與艾莉西亞·維坎德、文森特·卡塞爾等眾多明星聯袂出擊,共同面對新的危機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Matt Damon returns as Jason Bourne in Jason Bourne, with director Paul Greengrass back for another thrilling chapter. Bourne is drawn out of hiding, facing new dangers with Alicia Vikander, Vincent Cassel, and more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑瑞德・巴特勒與尼可拉・科斯特-瓦爾道主演,化身彼此對立的諸神,展開一場決定宇宙命運的史詩對決,震撼人心的奇幻冒險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gerard Butler and Nikolaj Coster-Waldau star as rival gods locked in an epic battle to decide the fate of the universe in this thrilling fantasy-adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The worldwide phenomenon continues. Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) has survived and destroyed the Hunger Games, and now rises with District 13 to fight against President Snow (Donald Sutherland).

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Arnold Schwarzenegger reprises his career-changing role as the Terminator in this explosive film that was selected as one of AFI’s Top Ten Sci-Fi films of all time.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Corrupt tycoon kills witness to a crime. Only the girlfriend of a businessman with Chinese govt. ties saw it. Beijing bodyguard helps Hong Kong police protect her. But he and the witness develop feelings, complicating matters.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhang and Jin’s daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he d

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 展昭、白玉堂武功不相上下。白一次無意中救了皇帝獲嘉封,卻不相信其身份,揚長而去。後皇帝再遇險,被展所救,展即獲御封。白不忿設計盜去玉璽,欲戲弄展,幸展武功高強,終不辱皇命而回。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhan and Bai are equally matched in martial arts skills. Bai saves the Emperor one day but did not believe in his identity and rejects a promotion. When Zhan is promoted to the royal guard after saving the Emperor, Bai gets angry and tries to prank h

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大偉和小春是同胞兄弟,一個放浪,一個含蓄。小春在舞會邂逅女子珠迪,情心一片。大偉發現珠迪有個年老丈夫,得知此秘密,大偉以此威脅,迫珠迪和他幽會,自始珠迪周旋三個男人之間... 導演以女性角度大膽描寫男女情關,手法細膩,而結局亦出人意表。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Aptly described by its original title of Money, Sex And Love, this is a gripping drama about Judy, a woman with a rich husband as well as two lovers who happen to be brothers. Jenny Hu is Judy, and her knockout beauty makes this summer sizzle...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 元朝時,武林中人都在爭奪倚天劍、屠龍刀這兩件武林神器;兩件神器只需一併在手,方可找出秘密,雄霸天下。張無忌機緣巧合下練得九陽神功,因此也捲入了這場紛爭百年的武林是非中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Yuan Dynasty, martial artists everywhere battle for the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, as only when these two powerful weapons combine can a secret be revealed to help one become the king of the martial arts world. As Zhang Wu Ji acquires

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 富家小姐梅淑卿與窮教師江少文,為了自由戀愛,脫離父母,從城市遷往小鎮結婚生活。他們生育五個兒女,但生存的擔子日重,二人長期辛勞,終相繼亡故。小兒女頓失庇蔭,直接面對複雜的社會,幾乎各散東西……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少女林曉虹因父母雙亡,只得投奔她的舅父方振權。方振權是鄉下土財主,膝下有二子,長子方正勇敢正直;次子方風則好賭成性,喜拈花惹草。某日,風 在方家花園裡,方風發現有一少女,乘她不防上前擁抱,少女竭力抗拒,方正聞聲趕來,方風才知道少女就是表妹林曉虹。然方風色心未退…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hung is an orphan seeking help from her wealthy uncle who has two sons but only dotes on the younger son Feng, a playboy. Feng covets the beauty of Hung and rapes her but when she gets pregnant, Hung is wrongfully accused and gets sent off by her unc

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窮書生林肇德與富翁女兒訂親,但富翁因其家道中落而反對婚事。為迎娶摯愛,肇德上京考取功名,臨行前會晤未婚妻,怎料卻碰上婢女滿身鮮血伏屍後花園。因不慎留下血手印於門上,他更被誣陷殺人。直至包公及時重審,為他洗脫冤情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy family’s daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his family’s background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancée, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody h

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全片由“天堂”、“人間”、“地獄” 三個故事組成,帶領觀眾穿梭三個時空。巡宮仙使辛靈,則是貫穿全片的核心人物。他最初因掩護仙界同僚逃出天宮, 而被貶落凡間,在人間因營救逃亡夫婦,不幸重傷身亡,到了地獄又協助冤鬼殺死仇敵。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple an

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片由兩個單元故事組成。首個故事講述柳宣教策劃了一個破玉通禪師「色戒」之奇計,著美豔妓女紅蓮向玉通大施色誘攻勢。第二個故事講述少女馮玉華之母馮孫氏欠下九尾狐一筆錢無法償還,被逼做妓女還債。後馮孫氏因性病死去,遺下一筆債務以及殮葬費須玉華償還;玉華無奈,只好踏上母親所走過之路...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is th

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年青馬車伕鍾堅因救助少女而與惡霸結怨。馬車老闆恐惹禍上身,把他辭退。鍾堅決志除暴安良,隨少林蔡李佛名家習武,向惡勢力挑戰。最後,他將惡霸除掉,令地方歸於平靜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the “Tsai Li Fu” style of martial arts from a Shaolin m

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部武俠傳奇故事,集合瑰麗的畫面、詭秘懸疑、權力鬥爭及動作于一身,成功地將精彩的動作場面與緊湊的劇情結合。藉江湖兩大幫會內部叛變,從而刻劃出人性叵測及真善混淆的一面。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鐵匠仇子玉,擅打利刀,且為武林高手,本已退隱江湖,但正氣未泯,應武林大豪屠一堃之邀,聯手對抗四大巨盜,奪回價值連城的飛龍璧物歸原主。誰知屠只是利用「鷸蚌相爭,漁人得利」的局面奪取該璧據為己有,事成後仇亦慘遭毒手。飛刀手雲翔知悉屠之卑鄙手段後,登時大發志士之憤,勇闖屠佈下之旗陣奪取飛龍璧,交回偵緝隊長

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影講述傅紅雪為了應付勢力龐大的陰謀家公子羽,除了力敵對方的爪牙,亦要智破對方的詭計。憑藉出色的武打設計、華麗的佈景、唯美的拍攝技巧及強勁的演員陣容,《天涯明月刀》在武俠電影的歷史上創下高鋒。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen’s brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pis

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 神刀大俠臨終時,把神刀傳給了徒弟林振嘯,而且更識破了另一徒弟方世雄為奪神刀而混入門下的奸計。方世雄為了神刀,令林家破人亡和雙目失明。最後,林振嘯與方世雄大戰為家人報仇,並誓要重奪神刀…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一次醉酒後,武松赤手空拳打死一隻猛虎,因此被任命為都頭。武松兄長武大郎的妻子潘金蓮色誘武松,但遭他拒絕。後來,潘金蓮和富戶西門慶有染,及後姦情敗露,兩人繼而毒死了武大郎。武松知悉後,先殺潘金蓮再殺西門慶,為兄長報仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歐陽鋒得悉郭靖以九陰真經的功夫於選婿比武中獲勝,並娶得黃蓉為妻,於是把黃蓉挾走,要脅郭靖要默寫九陰真經才會釋放黃蓉。最終郭靖會否為救出黃蓉而就範?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong’s hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 滿清入主中原後,北少林為免遭剿滅,只好受命派出弟子到清軍府擔任教頭,誰知抵達後,始知府中已有南少林教頭;期間將軍挑動兩派人不和繼而公開比武互相殘殺,後南派因弟子傷亡而與北派交惡,展開一番互相殘殺...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Kil

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三個香港美少女何莉莉、陳依齡及淩雲,帶著愛情夢遠赴日本大阪,一心指望釣得如意郎君。豈料三人被誤會是富家千金,結果惹出趣事連篇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 姜大衛飾演一個寧願自廢右臂退出江湖,也不願委屈求全的大俠,一直過著隱姓埋名的生活。直到至愛被綁架,好兄弟被殺害,他誓要重出江湖與惡勢力一戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武則天有傾國之貌,絕世才華,十四歲時更被唐太宗召為才人,但太宗死後卻入寺為尼,卻又與繼位之唐高宗有染,生有二子。時皇后與蕭妃爭寵,命武則天回宮以制妃子,卻反陷害皇后。武則天獲封皇后之後,更誅殺兩太子。直到高宗病亡,武后臨朝,成為史上第一個女皇帝。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 「劍神」三少爺是武林中的一大高手,但他因疲于應付上門挑戰的劍客,決定假裝死亡,隱姓埋名,並過著寧靜平凡的生活。可惜江湖上的人仍千方百計要向三少爺挑戰,令他被逼再度出手,不得不重現江湖。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Third Master is a renowned swordsman in the martial arts world, but the constant challenges by other swordsmen compel him to fake his death and pursue a secluded life. This does not prevent others from seeking him out to challenge him however, and he

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一次偶然機會下,富家子大用巧遇育幼院院長之外甥女連蓮。二人初次見面,雙方即發生誤會,大用更在匆忙間遺下皮包。當大用硬將連蓮假裝成爲自己的未婚妻好讓兩個傾慕他的女子死心時,又與連蓮發生了第二次誤會...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to ge

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鳳飛飛為報姊仇,發現兇手竟為未來夫婿金連白,不知所措。而殺姊夫之兇手蕭豹與梁霸為除後患,與金夫人聯手對付飛飛,欲滅絕鳳家。飛飛怒不可遏,合父母之力將惡贼擊斃。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sisters death, but is shocked to discover that her fiancé, Jin, is one of them.  At the same time, Jins mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng.  Can F

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漢朝末年太師董卓霸道專橫,弄權禍國,忠臣王允誓要利用貂蟬的美色設計除掉董卓。王允得知董卓的義子呂布見貂蟬貌若天仙一見鍾情,於是將計就計把貂蟬獻給董卓為妾,終使父子反目。呂布最後殺了父親董卓,自此與貂蟬成為眷屬。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn’s beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong’s concubine as he knows Dong’s adopted son Lu Bu is in love w

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主角小雜種由隱士撫養並授以武術;一天,隱士囑他下山訪尋父母。途中,他體驗到人情冷暖,先與女乞丐小乙惺惺相惜,建立「同是天涯淪落人」的友 誼,亦與邑紳之子顧英豪結怨。最後,他終於從妓院鴇母口中得知自己的身世,原來其生母本在顧家為婢,被老爺引誘成姦後,又遭虐待致死…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由老木匠收養的石生,長大後發現自己擁有異於常人的超能力,原來他乃是太陽神之子,但每逢日蝕的時候,石生便會失去超能力。一天,惡魔出現並大肆殺戮和破壞,石生誓與惡魔決一死戰以拯救世界。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白蓮教主六十餘歲,紅顏白髮,練就絕招,能閉全身穴道,武功高深莫測,卻甘作滿清鷹犬,暗中協助師侄高進忠,消滅反清志士及破壞重建少林寺;洪文定為少林英雄洪熙官之子,曾擊斃白之師弟白眉道人,名震江湖。白與高偵知洪住反清志士胡亞彪家中,夜襲殺胡及其妹,洪幸護著身懷六甲的胡妻突圍逃走...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Lo’s brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hu’s house. The clan att

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少女美麗為謀生來到灣仔酒吧當吧女,自此淪落風塵。其後,美麗在酒吧認識占美,深深愛上他,並確定自己已找到真愛。當占美要離開的時候,傷心的美麗即陷入低潮,直到遇上黑幫頭目王英才有了倚靠。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失蹤五年的無翼蝙蝠,忽然重出江湖,姦淫少女。風流大俠蕭七與總鏢頭雷迅追查真相,並發現無翼蝙蝠可能被嫁禍。傳說無翼蝙蝠的蝙蝠刀內藏有蝙蝠寶圖,於是他們將計就計,借刀引出幕後真兇…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Bat Without Wings, a notorious rapist-murderer, has returned after a five-year absence. A young swordsman and a convoy master investigate the case and suspect that the Bat may be framed. A saying goes that a treasure map is hidden under the Bat’s

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and ser

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang’s. On the Chang’s farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部電影改編自中國史上最廣受歡迎的文學作品《紅樓夢》,被譽為同名電影中最成功的作品。樂蒂生動地詮釋了美麗卻帶有一絲哀愁的林黛玉角色,也因此贏得了「古典美人」的美譽。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Loh’s looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet Classic Beauty.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李岳為報父仇暗殺高官後遭通緝,隱姓埋名成為逃犯。他的未婚妻貞兒委託暗戀她的劍客方君兆尋找愛郎,卻不知女盜賊小眉早已對李岳暗生情愫。他們錯綜複雜的愛情四角關係展現出無悔的割捨、付出與無私而偉大的情感。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yens family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在這部浪漫愛情經典中,夜總會歌女李青青邂逅英俊青年湯鵬南,兩人漸生情愫,卻在感情路上經歷無數誤會、分離和折磨。當他們終於重燃愛火時,青青卻得知一個噩耗,最終無奈迎來悲慘的結局。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莊主杜天道其子被人斬去雙臂,性格變得暴戾。無故地先後打傷四人致殘。四人成殘缺一族,走投無路,入深山找師父授以武功,立志報仇…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son’s arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yu Fang Fang survives the massacre of her masters family at the hands of the Crimson Charm gang but loses her arm in the process. Determined, she vows to team up with a swordsman seeking revenge against the ruthless gang.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Sh

Witness how they compete in front of the star athletes and legendary dodgeball coaches!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 商人Burks被一對走投無路的夫婦綁架,被迫踏上開往洛杉磯的亡命之旅。途中危機四伏,三人發現彼此隱藏著致命的秘密。一場原本以為簡單的綁架,卻演變成奪命的博弈,當中沒有人能按計劃全身而退!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kidnapped by a desperate couple, businessman Burks Hill is forced on a frantic journey to Los Angeles. As danger mounts, the three travellers discover that they each harbour deadly secrets. What began as a simple kidnapping spirals into a lethal game where no ones plan will survive.

epg.programme_title_tc: R U Tough Enough: Toughness Redefined
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The growing regional competition R U Tough Enough is searching for the toughest person from Southeast Asia. Join the search and meet some of the most mentally and physically strong individuals, leading up to an epic final showdown in Kuala Lumpur for the prize of US$15,000!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 業餘女拳手Koy在泰拳比賽中慘遭擊倒,竟墜入內心深處的恐懼與痛苦之中,並喚醒一片超現實夢境。在一名神秘男子的步步引導下,她必須憑藉傳統古泰拳的千鈞爆發力,隻身對抗層出不窮的幻覺與心魔,挑戰潛藏於內心深..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After being defeated in a championship match, Muay Thai fighter Koy awakens in a surreal dreamscape shaped by her fears. Guided by a mysterious man, she must master Korat-style Muay Thai to battle violent illusions and buried trauma. As darkness closes in, Koy fights to reclaim her true identity and survive the ultimate test within her mind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年輕刺客青面修羅接受人生首份刺殺任務,同時暗中調查當年自己家族滅門慘案幕後起因。但任務還未完成,他發現自己已經捲入了一場策劃多年的陰謀當中,唯有利用自己的刺客技能,一一破局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

epg.programme_title_tc: Live and Die in East LA
epg.programme_title_en: Live and Die in East LA
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 急診醫生Attila救治一名車禍男童後,意外捲入洛杉磯東區的黑道糾紛。男童竟是黑幫頭目的兒子,而車禍則是預謀的幫派復仇。為救涉案的妹妹免於牢獄之災,Attila被迫成為黑幫的運毒棋子,由此引發一場血腥..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After treating a boy injured in a hit-and-run, ER doctor Attila is drawn into East L.A.’s underworld conflict. The boy is the son of a crime lord, and the “accident” was gang revenge. To save his sister from prison, Attila becomes a drug courier, igniting a gang war that forces a tragic choice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金牌保鏢龍威在妻子慘死後患上了創傷後應激障礙,心情低落。他意外結識高科技公司職員Amy,在她邀請下參加了新產品的虛擬測試。龍威測試成功後即成為該公司的虛擬特攻,更獲試用新發明的防護機甲,不料遭遇神秘武..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wifes death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退出江湖的特工華叔,在老街以開古董店為生。一天,老街遭當地青龍幫強拆時,華叔隱藏的身份被暴露,並受到阿傑為首的神秘組織追殺,由此展開了一場雙雄對決!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua’s hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Extreme Ends是個動作冒險真人秀節目,邀請四位名人及其特別嘉賓一同體驗香港的多元魅力!讓我們與兩位泰國藝人Gun和Ticha一起展開旅程,探索香港繁華的城市生活和幽靜的郊區。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Embark on the journey with two Thai artistes, Gun and Ticha, as they navigate the bustling city life and discover the serene outskirts of Hong Kong.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 視覺是最令人驚嘆的感官,為物種帶來無窮的適應能力.不同動物的眼睛賦予牠們截然不同的視覺,在某些情況下甚至讓人「眼界大開」.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seeing the world is one of the most amazing animal adaptations. Different types of eyes give animals different types of vision, and in some cases they can be extraordinary.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來認識小雌豹奇帕祖亞的魅力,她受到母親的悉心照顧,因此從未需要自己捕獵.這是她生命中第一次獨自生活,她能否絕地求生,培養出所需的狩獵技能?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet pampered young leopardess Chipadzua, who has never had to hunt for food, thanks to her patient mother. Alone for the first time in her life, will she develop the skills it takes to survive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 野狗群的世界正在面對一場巨變,他們豐富的狩獵地正受到斑點鬣狗群的威脅.脆弱的狗寶寶已開始挨餓,因為無情的獵食者對手偷走了他們的食物,最終還突擊他們的棲身地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Enter the world of a wild dog pack whose bountiful hunting grounds are threatened when a clan of spotted hyenas moves in nearby. The vulnerable pups start to go hungry as the scavenging rivals steal their food and eventually raid their den.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中.與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​帶你發現那座位於波濤之下,眾城之中最奇幻壯麗的城市,那裡是愛情滋長與通勤旅者聚集之地,珊瑚礁主幹道宛如繁忙街道,浪漫與遷徙生命在其中交錯如潮.跟隨一隻懷抱愛意的綠蠵龜,展開牠的尋愛旅程;坐下來,陪伴一位鶴鴕爸爸細心守護他那剛孵化的小寶寶們.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the most fantastic city of them all lying beneath the waves, where romance and migratory commuters flood the coral reefs main highways. Follow a green sea turtle looking for love and sit in with a cassowary dad tending his newborn chicks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​感受盛夏降臨時的灼熱氣息,體型龐大的海蝸牛試圖抵禦一群貪吃珊瑚的海星幫派入侵.與礁鯊一同巡遊黑夜,尋找宵夜佳餚;驚嘆鸚哥魚如何巧妙變身,以滑溜偽裝度過危機四伏的漫漫長夜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat of summers arrival as supersize sea snails try to fend off an invading gang of coral-hungry starfish. Accompany reef sharks as they prowl for a midnight meal and marvel at the slippery disguise a parrotfish uses to survive the night.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪婆羅洲的紅樹林,與灣鱷一同航行,並見證牠們在盤根錯節的水生植物之間穿梭自如.了解牠們如何利用環境調節體溫,以及如何憑藉驚人的耐性一躍成為頂尖獵手.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate a mangrove forest in Borneo with the saltwater crocodile, which is perfectly suited to life among the watery roots. Discover how this reptile uses the environment to regulate its temperature and why its epic patience makes it a super hunter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 農場裡的動物為一年中最短的日子專心準備.為免冬天太沉悶,牛群享受假日美食和演唱會.母豬舒娜忙著照料九隻貪玩的小豬,而公羊哈米殊被大眾情人邦妮嫌棄.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is coming, and the animals take advantage of autumns final bounty before the cold, barren months ahead. Watch some creatures search for respite indoors, while others arrive from far northern climates to settle in the ploughed fields.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 所有的運動都會產生聲波;有些物種成功演化出器官來檢測空氣或水中的聲波,以感知環境中的運動.齊來暸解這些動物的敏銳聽覺.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sound waves are produced by movement. Animals have evolved organs to detect those sound waves in the air or water to perceive movements in their environment. These are some of the animals that have mastered the sense of hearing.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat of summers arrival as supersize sea snails try to fend off an invading gang of coral-hungry starfish. Accompany reef sharks as they prowl for a midnight meal and marvel at the slippery disguise a parrotfish uses to survive the night.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證鬥士們如何在非洲大草原的旱季中爭奪水源和其他珍貴資源.親眼目擊獅子和大象為爭奪地盤的激烈爭鬥,螞蟻襲擊白蟻丘,以及蜜獾與毒蛇聯袂上演的危險探戈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. See a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound, and a honey badgers risky dance with a deadly snake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的秋天帶來機會.非洲毛皮海獅,白喉猴,變色龍和黑斑羚等對秋季有所反應.秋天引發了許多動物的生活變化.稀有生物露面,獵食者聚集起來製造優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As fall sweeps across America and trees are set ablaze with color, animals are faced with make-or-break decisions. Find out how bald eagles, beavers, and other creatures prepare for the colder, darker, and leaner months ahead.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的冬天帶來乾旱,冰雪和風暴.在此生活的動物必須與天氣,土地和彼此競爭.獵豹,海豹,禿鷹和狐獴.雨水終於結束旱季,並引發了生命的爆發性發展.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is the ultimate challenge for wildlife across America. Will they escape to milder southern climates or stay put and tough out the season? See how different creatures respond to the brutal cold and blizzards that blanket the North.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅毛猩猩是叢林中的建築大師.跟隨麥克斯來到婆羅洲的雨林,一起探索這種獨居靈長類動物的築巢藝術.然後見證麥克斯如何嘗試逃離滿佈昆蟲的地面,並從紅毛猩猩身上學習自然界工程技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungles master builder: the orangutan. Shadow Max as he tries to escape the insect-filled floor of the Borneo rainforest and takes inspiration from this solitary primates natural engineering prowess.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭南島的西南角被巨大的山脈和蠻荒的太平洋所封閉.稀有的企鵝每天都被逼與巨型胡氏海獅進行貓捉老鼠的遊戲.而海獅也生活在一個動蕩的世界,幼獅必須對抗大自然才能生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience unbelievable acts of courage and loyalty by creatures trying to survive in the remote wilderness of New Zealands South Island. Face forest penguins feast and famine cycles, and explore the tumultuous world of newborn sea lions.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some animals have senses that humans cant even conceive. With those powers they can do marvelous things.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜訪澳洲最狡猾的鬥士和他們驚人的武器庫.從袋鼠的致命拳擊和紅背蜘蛛精密設計的陷阱,暸解他們如何運用這些必殺技擊退敵人,同時應對氣候變化的侵害.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against Australias wiliest gladiators and their impressive arsenals. Learn if these weapons, such as the kangaroos deadly boxing moves and the redback spiders precision-engineered traps, can help them survive the ravages of climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨溫斯頓和姐妹花搬進新建的居所,並努力學習野外生存技能.目睹雅思敏和雅拉在幼兒園中的權力鬥爭,然後關注不安分的幼熊維克多;因為牠突然跛腳,野放的日子要一再延後.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bone up on outdoor skills as Winston and the X girls move into their new fresh-air enclosure, and witness Yasmine and Yaras kindergarten power struggle. Then look over restless yearling Victor, whose sudden limp pushes back his release date.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與雅思敏和雅拉一起在雨中嬉戲和享受攀爬的樂趣,並跟隨溫斯頓在新水池中的暢泳.與羅傑和史蒂夫一起尋找掉落的無線電項圈,並見證兩群夏季幼熊的首次相遇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the joys of rain and climbing with Yasmine and Yara, and watch Winston take a dip in his new pool. Go hunting for dropped radio collars with Roger and Steve, then see what happens when the two groups of summer cubs come face-to-face.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麥克斯來到盧安達的森林追蹤黑猩猩,他試圖說服這些強壯的猴子相信他是朋友而非敵人.一起學習在叢林覓食的關鍵技巧,並見證黑猩猩複雜的家庭動態,包括梳理毛髮和社交活動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track chimpanzees through the Rwandan forest with Max, who tries to convince these powerful monkeys that hes a friend, not a foe. Pick up some key tips on jungle dining and witness complex family dynamics, including grooming and socializing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新西蘭西南部,深邃的峽灣和潮汐形成的潟湖被綠色的雨林覆蓋.生活在黑暗峽灣港的生物通常棲息在深海.隨著冬季將至,寬吻海豚必須逃離牠們冰冷的峽灣,而在山河中,新西蘭長鰭鰻細聽大海的呼喚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how winters arrival triggers animal survival instincts in southwestern New Zealand. Track dolphins as they move to warmer waters to give their calves a fighting chance, and join longfin eels on an epic migration to their spawning grounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的秋天帶來機會.非洲毛皮海獅,白喉猴,變色龍和黑斑羚等對秋季有所反應.秋天引發了許多動物的生活變化.稀有生物露面,獵食者聚集起來製造優勢.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的冬天帶來乾旱,冰雪和風暴.在此生活的動物必須與天氣,土地和彼此競爭.獵豹,海豹,禿鷹和狐獴.雨水終於結束旱季,並引發了生命的爆發性發展.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is the ultimate challenge for wildlife across America. Will they escape to milder southern climates or stay put and tough out the season? See how different creatures respond to the brutal cold and blizzards that blanket the North.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然的清潔專家學習環境衛生課.了解甲蟲如何利用尖牙與毒液等生物武器,巧妙維持生態平衡,並認識超過六千種的糞金龜──這些無名英雄才是維護地球健康的關鍵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get a sanitation lesson from natures original cleanup crew. Learn how beetles keep ecosystems in balance with clever biological weapons like tusks and toxic sprays, then see why the 6,000-plus species of dung beetles are the worlds unsung heroes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨溫斯頓和姐妹花搬進新建的居所,並努力學習野外生存技能.目睹雅思敏和雅拉在幼兒園中的權力鬥爭,然後關注不安分的幼熊維克多;因為牠突然跛腳,野放的日子要一再延後.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bone up on outdoor skills as Winston and the X girls move into their new fresh-air enclosure, and witness Yasmine and Yaras kindergarten power struggle. Then look over restless yearling Victor, whose sudden limp pushes back his release date.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與雅思敏和雅拉一起在雨中嬉戲和享受攀爬的樂趣,並跟隨溫斯頓在新水池中的暢泳.與羅傑和史蒂夫一起尋找掉落的無線電項圈,並見證兩群夏季幼熊的首次相遇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the joys of rain and climbing with Yasmine and Yara, and watch Winston take a dip in his new pool. Go hunting for dropped radio collars with Roger and Steve, then see what happens when the two groups of summer cubs come face-to-face.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麥克斯來到盧安達的森林追蹤黑猩猩,他試圖說服這些強壯的猴子相信他是朋友而非敵人.一起學習在叢林覓食的關鍵技巧,並見證黑猩猩複雜的家庭動態,包括梳理毛髮和社交活動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track chimpanzees through the Rwandan forest with Max, who tries to convince these powerful monkeys that hes a friend, not a foe. Pick up some key tips on jungle dining and witness complex family dynamics, including grooming and socializing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新西蘭西南部,深邃的峽灣和潮汐形成的潟湖被綠色的雨林覆蓋.生活在黑暗峽灣港的生物通常棲息在深海.隨著冬季將至,寬吻海豚必須逃離牠們冰冷的峽灣,而在山河中,新西蘭長鰭鰻細聽大海的呼喚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how winters arrival triggers animal survival instincts in southwestern New Zealand. Track dolphins as they move to warmer waters to give their calves a fighting chance, and join longfin eels on an epic migration to their spawning grounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人類擁有敏銳的感官,亦是我們能探索環境的關鍵.不同感官向我們提供生存所需的重要訊息.然而,部份物種也能掌握這些感官,並透過演化轉化成生物工程的奇蹟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Humans have sharp senses, which we use to explore our environment. They give us the information we need to survive. But some animals have taken those senses and, through evolution, turned them into marvels of biological engineering.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨溫斯頓和姐妹花搬進新建的居所,並努力學習野外生存技能.目睹雅思敏和雅拉在幼兒園中的權力鬥爭,然後關注不安分的幼熊維克多;因為牠突然跛腳,野放的日子要一再延後.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喀爾巴阡山脈橫跨七個歐洲國家;它有著廣闊的原始森林,陡峭的峽谷和孤立的山峰,為這片大陸最具魅力的生物提供了寶貴的避難所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join a mother brown bear as she struggles to find food for her two young cubs while teaching them essential skills for the harsh winter ahead. Then visit a pair of tiny lynx kittens as they begin to venture away from the safety of their den.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub. See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧.與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麥可斯探索斯里蘭卡,窺探懶熊常被誤解的神秘世界.見證這種看似人畜無害,毛髮蓬亂的動物,如何無畏地擊退豹子,並觀察牠們如何努力獲取所需的營養.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peek inside the secret world of the fearless, often misunderstood sloth bear. Travel to Sri Lanka with Max and discover how this fierce, shaggy animal fights off leopards and other deadly rivals, all while trying to secure enough protein to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭東南岸是世上最富饒的漁場之一,也是海洋動物嬰孩從新丁長大成人之地.年輕的鯨魚,海豚和海豹學習捕獵;學習社會規則,甚至開始自己的冒險.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蜂巢內,成千上萬的小動物朝著一個共同目標努力:群體的生存.但是個別蜜蜂的生活又如何?秘「蜜」日記講述這個故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bees Diary tells that story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麥可斯探索斯里蘭卡,窺探懶熊常被誤解的神秘世界.見證這種看似人畜無害,毛髮蓬亂的動物,如何無畏地擊退豹子,並觀察牠們如何努力獲取所需的營養.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peek inside the secret world of the fearless, often misunderstood sloth bear. Travel to Sri Lanka with Max and discover how this fierce, shaggy animal fights off leopards and other deadly rivals, all while trying to secure enough protein to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭東南岸是世上最富饒的漁場之一,也是海洋動物嬰孩從新丁長大成人之地.年輕的鯨魚,海豚和海豹學習捕獵;學習社會規則,甚至開始自己的冒險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The south-eastern coast of New Zealand are some of the richest fishing grounds in the world – the place for young marine animals to transition from novices to independent adults. Young whales, dolphins and seals learn to hunt, learn the rules of s...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨溫斯頓和姐妹花搬進新建的居所,並努力學習野外生存技能.目睹雅思敏和雅拉在幼兒園中的權力鬥爭,然後關注不安分的幼熊維克多;因為牠突然跛腳,野放的日子要一再延後.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bone up on outdoor skills as Winston and the X girls move into their new fresh-air enclosure, and witness Yasmine and Yaras kindergarten power struggle. Then look over restless yearling Victor, whose sudden limp pushes back his release date.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與雅思敏和雅拉一起在雨中嬉戲和享受攀爬的樂趣,並跟隨溫斯頓在新水池中的暢泳.與羅傑和史蒂夫一起尋找掉落的無線電項圈,並見證兩群夏季幼熊的首次相遇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the joys of rain and climbing with Yasmine and Yara, and watch Winston take a dip in his new pool. Go hunting for dropped radio collars with Roger and Steve, then see what happens when the two groups of summer cubs come face-to-face.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蜂巢內,成千上萬的小動物朝著一個共同目標努力:群體的生存.但是個別蜜蜂的生活又如何?秘「蜜」日記講述這個故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bees Diary tells that story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub. See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧.與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 您曾否想過為何山魈的臉如此七彩,禿鷹為何禿頭,甚至雙髻鯊為何有雙髻?發掘動物如何通過脖子以上的進化來生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Have you ever wondered why mandrills have such colorful faces, why vultures are bald, or even why hammerheads have, well, hammer-shaped heads? Discover how animals managed to survive by evolving from the neck up.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塔特南角的11月,冬天將至哈德遜灣的下西部海岸線,但原本應該在哈德遜灣出現的冰卻不見蹤影.2016年是有紀錄以來最溫暖的一年,11月下旬時,仍然比平均溫度高出10度.氣候變化肆虐北方,大海不能在接近冰點結冰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its November at Cape Tatnam. Winter is coming to the lower Western shore of Hudson Bay. But the ice - which should be forming on Hudson Bay by now - is nowhere to be seen. 2016 has been the warmest year on record. In late November, the temperatur...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亞拉國家公園中陰暗的森林,對行縱隱密的豹來說是完美的藏身之所;而年輕的䧳豹阿莎亦準備好獨自闖蕩.一起見證她爭奪自己的領地,尋找伴侶,到成為母親的歷程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The shadowy forests of Yala National Park are the perfect hideout for secretive leopards. Its time for one young female, Asha, to strike out alone. Join her as she fights for her own territory, finds a mate, and becomes a mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亞洲最大的象群每年都會齊集於米內瑞亞國家公園舉行盛會;而在本年的周年大會上,於這片神聖的地方,小象洛卡誕生了!一起見證他在大象的混戰中學習進食,游泳和使用他的象鼻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every year, the biggest elephant congregation in Asia occurs in Minneriya National Park. Here in this sacred place, baby Loka is born. Watch as he learns to suckle, swim and handle his trunk among the mêlée of giants that make up his family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 斯里蘭卡的低地遍布著數千個看似平靜的湖泊,但「湖」不可貌相,湖水中盡是沼澤鱷的天下.沼澤鱷生來就是獵人,一起來看看這些頂尖獵食者在炙熱的環境中如何互相競爭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sri Lankas lowlands are dotted with thousands of seemingly peaceful lakes, but dont be fooled, this is the realm of the mugger crocodile. Muggers are hunters from day one. Watch as these supreme predators compete with each other in the fierce heat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於明尼亞瑞亞國家公園的一座人造湖,養育了亞洲最大的象群.跟隨一頭年輕公象,他正在經歷成長的轉折點.走訪熱帶雨林,探索棲居於叢林中各種奇異的昆蟲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A manmade lake in Minneriya National Park supports the largest concentration of elephants in Asia. Follow a young male who has reached a turning point toward adulthood. In the rainforest, jungles teem with a variety of bizarre species of insects.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 季候風暴席捲斯里蘭卡的熱帶島嶼,帶著旋風的薄霧和水流襲擊了山區的心臟地帶,開展島上森林許多不斷變化的面貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Monsoon storms sweep over the tropical island of Sri Lanka, and water carried in with swirling mists hits the mountainous heartland, beginning a journey through the many changing faces of the islands forests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雅拉國家公園是一個鳥類伊甸園,是215種鳥類的家.這個天堂為能度過不斷變化氣候的父母提供了許多可能性. 在旱季結束和季侯風風暴開始前,每個物種都必須在這裡飼養後代或找到新家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yala National Park is an avian Eden, home to 215 species of bird. This paradise offers many possibilities for parents who can weather the ever-changing climate. Every species must either raise their offspring here or find a new home before the dry...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與非洲森林象一同穿越納米比亞沙漠,窺探牠們如何在缺乏食物與遮蔽的環境中保持涼爽.了解這頭巨獸如何挑選特定植物充飢,挖掘水井,並翻越無盡的沙丘尋找珍貴水源.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across the Namibian desert with the bush elephant and learn how it keeps its cool in a place with little food or shade. Discover how this giant consumes specific plants, digs wells, and hikes endless dunes in a quest to find precious water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪婆羅洲的紅樹林,與灣鱷一同航行,並見證牠們在盤根錯節的水生植物之間穿梭自如.了解牠們如何利用環境調節體溫,以及如何憑藉驚人的耐性一躍成為頂尖獵手.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate a mangrove forest in Borneo with the saltwater crocodile, which is perfectly suited to life among the watery roots. Discover how this reptile uses the environment to regulate its temperature and why its epic patience makes it a super hunter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅毛猩猩是叢林中的建築大師.跟隨麥克斯來到婆羅洲的雨林,一起探索這種獨居靈長類動物的築巢藝術.然後見證麥克斯如何嘗試逃離滿佈昆蟲的地面,並從紅毛猩猩身上學習自然界工程技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungles master builder: the orangutan. Shadow Max as he tries to escape the insect-filled floor of the Borneo rainforest and takes inspiration from this solitary primates natural engineering prowess.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麥克斯來到盧安達的森林追蹤黑猩猩,他試圖說服這些強壯的猴子相信他是朋友而非敵人.一起學習在叢林覓食的關鍵技巧,並見證黑猩猩複雜的家庭動態,包括梳理毛髮和社交活動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track chimpanzees through the Rwandan forest with Max, who tries to convince these powerful monkeys that hes a friend, not a foe. Pick up some key tips on jungle dining and witness complex family dynamics, including grooming and socializing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麥可斯探索斯里蘭卡,窺探懶熊常被誤解的神秘世界.見證這種看似人畜無害,毛髮蓬亂的動物,如何無畏地擊退豹子,並觀察牠們如何努力獲取所需的營養.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peek inside the secret world of the fearless, often misunderstood sloth bear. Travel to Sri Lanka with Max and discover how this fierce, shaggy animal fights off leopards and other deadly rivals, all while trying to secure enough protein to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然中最古老,最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bow down to one of natures most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟著各式各樣的鯊魚在海洋中巡游,看看為什麼這些掠食性魚類能夠稱霸海底世界.和礁鯊一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宮之中,和鬚鯊一起潛伏等待最完美的攻擊時機,並和大白鯊一起展開史詩般的大遷徙.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中.與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與地球上最快的動物運動員一起加速.觀看死亡加德蛇在瞬間出擊,與遊隼一起進行空中暗殺,與變色龍一起捕捉快速的食物,並面對在海雀俯衝獵物時的驚人G力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 齊來為年輕的格鬥士們鼓掌,並親眼見證他們在美洲茂密的熱帶森林中奮力拼搏!然後退後一步,觀察一隻毒箭蛙發動絕活攻勢,還有美洲豹和凱門鱷爭奪地盤,以及見證一隻飢餓的長鼻狸與猛蜘蛛的邂逅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cheer as young gladiators earn their stripes in the dense tropical forests of the Americas. Stand back as a poison dart frog launches a toxic barrage, observe a jaguar-caiman turf war, and see a hungry coati cross paths with a defensive tarantula.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往美國極北地帶,拜訪沿著水道生活的終極格鬥士.春回大地,看到融雪就知道格鬥隨時上演:鷹與鷺的對決,熊族對陣,以及蜻蜓蛹與大型水蟲之間的決鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head to Americas far north for a peek at the ultimate fighters that live along its waterways. See a spring thaw kick off the competition, pitting eagles against herons, bears against bears, and dragonfly nymphs against venomous giant water bugs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在歐洲,喀爾巴阡山脈的偏遠荒野是由古老森林和陡峭峽谷組成的一片戲劇性土地.神秘生物在這處仍漫步野外,崎嶇的景觀是一種捕食者的家園,牠在整個歷史中刻下敬畏和恐懼:歐亞狼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the remote wilderness of the Carpathian Mountains lives an elusive predator that has inspired awe and fear throughout history: the Eurasian wolf. Discover the vital role that these once-misunderstood hunters play in protecting their ecosystem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 向大自然中最古老,最致命的耐力型掠食者之一低頭致敬.看虎鯊如何利用海龜築巢時的混亂展開獵食,和肩章鯊一起在缺氧環境中生存,並和幽靈鯊一起承受深海驚人的高壓.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the remote wilderness of the Carpathian Mountains lives an elusive predator that has inspired awe and fear throughout history: the Eurasian wolf. Discover the vital role that these once-misunderstood hunters play in protecting their ecosystem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在地理和生物學尺度上,人類只是霎眼間的存在罷了,但我們卻影響了許多動物的進化路徑.探索人類對狗,狼,郊狼和大象等的影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In geological and biological scales, humans have only been around for the blink of an eye, and yet weve managed to influence the evolutionary path for many animals. Explore the human impact on dogs, wolves, coyotes, elephants, and more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 波奈的裙礁是過千種珊瑚,魚類和其他海洋動物的家園,也是許多令人驚嘆的沉船的墓園.這些殘骸隨著時日的推移而進化成人工珊瑚,支撐著令人難以置信的多樣性海洋棲息地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bonaires fringing reef is home to thousands of species of corals, fish and other marine animals. It is also home to a collection of stunning shipwrecks. These wrecks evolve over time, becoming artificial reefs that support an incredibly diverse m...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨四個不同物種的四個家族-足智多謀的海灘族,好戰的沙漠族,紀律嚴明的河族和愛好和平的山族,找出這些靈長類成為非洲最成功動物之一的原因.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow four families of four different species - the resourceful Beach Troop, the warlike Desert Troop, the disciplined River Troop, and the peaceful Mountain Band - to find out why these primates are among the most successful animals in Africa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪地土的盡頭,一個極具生命力的自然劇場正在眼前上演.從微小的蝴蝶到巨大的座頭鯨,他們都走在地球演化的最前線,透過不斷改變行為來適應千變萬化的生境,並幫助我們解開對這個藍色星球的種種謎團.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to the ends of the Earth, where a drama is unfolding in real time. Meet animals, from tiny butterflies to huge humpback whales, that are acting as sentinels, adapting their behaviour, and helping us unlock the riddles of our changing planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 散落在不同海洋上的島嶼,其多樣性超乎想像;演化亦在你眼前發生.從加拉帕戈斯群島走到南極洲,看看海獅,雀鳥,蟋蟀,猴子和其他野生動物,如何以驚人的適應力來應對氣候變化問題.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Find out why islands are like mini-Earths where evolution happens before your eyes. Journey from the Galápagos to Antarctica to see how sea lions, finches, crickets, monkeys and other wildlife are finding surprising solutions to climatic problems.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從撒哈拉到荒野,於極端環境中學習動物如何適應急速變化的氣候並掙扎求存.與黑猩猩一起在洞穴中避難,看看駱駝以特別技巧飲用鹽水,並傾聽斑胸草雀為蛋寶寶由唱的歌,了解歌聲如何讓幼雛變得細小.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go to extremes, from the Sahara to the outback, where animals are teaching us how to survive in our heating world. Shelter in caves with chimps, see camels sip salt water, and listen as zebra finches sing to their eggs to make their chicks smaller.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起走訪迅速融化的極地,看看動物向科學家們留下有關我們未來存留的啟示與線索.了解北極熊,企鵝和其他極地生物的動靜如何幫助人類制定應對全球暖化之計.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek to the planets quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map (and prevent) global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上非常重要,卻受到忽視的棲息地之一,了解草原在減緩氣候變化上的角色,其吸收碳的容量比森林更大.接着拜會野牛和美洲獅等關鍵物種,看看他們如何幫助恢復生態資源,並治癒我們的星球.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore one of Earths most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. Meet key species, such as bison and pumas, that could restore this resource and heal our planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著葉子的變化,農場裡的動物露出野性.公羊羅傑和哈米殊就像擁有大角般對決,爭奪霸主地位.母雞莎莉飛過雞舍,在季末遊覽農場.母豬舒娜生下小豬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch life on the farm adjust as the leaves start to turn, from the sheep whose woolly coats keep them warm during the first frost to the bees that feed on the last bit of nectar before hibernation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 農場裡的動物為一年中最短的日子專心準備.為免冬天太沉悶,牛群享受假日美食和演唱會.母豬舒娜忙著照料九隻貪玩的小豬,而公羊哈米殊被大眾情人邦妮嫌棄.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is coming, and the animals take advantage of autumns final bounty before the cold, barren months ahead. Watch some creatures search for respite indoors, while others arrive from far northern climates to settle in the ploughed fields.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭南島的西南角被巨大的山脈和蠻荒的太平洋所封閉.稀有的企鵝每天都被逼與巨型胡氏海獅進行貓捉老鼠的遊戲.而海獅也生活在一個動蕩的世界,幼獅必須對抗大自然才能生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience unbelievable acts of courage and loyalty by creatures trying to survive in the remote wilderness of New Zealands South Island. Face forest penguins feast and famine cycles, and explore the tumultuous world of newborn sea lions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新西蘭西南部,深邃的峽灣和潮汐形成的潟湖被綠色的雨林覆蓋.生活在黑暗峽灣港的生物通常棲息在深海.隨著冬季將至,寬吻海豚必須逃離牠們冰冷的峽灣,而在山河中,新西蘭長鰭鰻細聽大海的呼喚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how winters arrival triggers animal survival instincts in southwestern New Zealand. Track dolphins as they move to warmer waters to give their calves a fighting chance, and join longfin eels on an epic migration to their spawning grounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭東南岸是世上最富饒的漁場之一,也是海洋動物嬰孩從新丁長大成人之地.年輕的鯨魚,海豚和海豹學習捕獵;學習社會規則,甚至開始自己的冒險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The south-eastern coast of New Zealand are some of the richest fishing grounds in the world – the place for young marine animals to transition from novices to independent adults. Young whales, dolphins and seals learn to hunt, learn the rules of s...

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​衝過昆士蘭東南地區,在繁殖與捕蛇的季節逐步升溫時,觀看阿黛兒與米克迎戰一條東部棕蛇,這是世界上第二致命的毒蛇,同時史都與麗芙則與一條地毯蟒糾纏搏鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dash across southeast Queensland as breeding and snake-catching season ramp up. Watch Adele and Mick go up against an eastern brown, the second deadliest snake in the world, while Stu and Liv tangle with a carpet python.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​隨著春季的蛇潮展開,跟隨麗芙與史都一起,他們在工地現場攔截兩條為爭奪交配權而決鬥的公棕蛇,這是一場激烈的爭鬥,一場關乎交配資格的爭戰.退後站觀,觀看丹與潔絲從一條蟒蛇手中救出雞群,而米克與阿黛兒則追捕一條失控的綠樹蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Launch into springs snake surge with Liv and Stu, who intercept two male brown snakes duelling for mating rights at a construction site. Stand back as Dan and Jess rescue chickens from a python, and Mick and Adele hunt for a rogue green tree snake.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​穿梭於昆士蘭沿海的混亂景象與喧囂之中,傑絲勇敢面對她內心的恐懼,追逐一隻攀爬至樹上的蕾絲蜥蜴,而那棵樹上還棲息著活躍繁忙的蜂巢.觀看斯圖小心翼翼地將一條被困在籬笆之間的東方褐蛇救出,並觀察米克為驚慌不安的屋主捕捉那條滑溜難抓,靈活的巨蟒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Weave through Queenslands coastal chaos, where Jess faces her fears chasing a lace monitor lizard up a tree with an active beehive. Watch Stu cut a trapped eastern brown out of a fence and see Mick hunt a slippery python for terrified homeowners.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​潛入狹小緊迫的空間之中,鑽入溫室的底部結構,並進入緊張刺激的救援現場,捕蛇人勇敢面對一條長達六英尺,極度有毒的褐蛇.隨後觀看斯圖與莉芙將威脅到屋主寵物安全的沿海巨蟒小心搬遷至安全地點.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive into tight spaces, underneath hot houses, and into tense rescue situations as the catchers confront a six-foot-long, highly venomous brown snake. Then watch Stu and Liv relocate a coastal python threatening the safety of a homeowners pets.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​衝進嶄新的郊區社區,馴蛇專家努力阻止致命毒蛇滑入普通家庭住宅.觀看斯圖與莉芙將一條東方褐蛇從工地移出,傑絲與丹將巨蟒從倉庫中驅逐出去,而米克與阿黛爾則將紅腹蛇趕出臥室,確保屋主生活區域的安全.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Storm into a new suburb, where the wranglers keep deadly snakes from slipping into family homes. Watch as Stu and Liv pull an eastern brown from a job site, Jess and Dan expel a python from a shed, and Mick and Adele evict a red belly from a bedroom.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在偏遠農村地產面對危險時,米克與阿黛爾勇敢無畏地應對一條激烈攻擊的褐蛇.傑絲與丹小心翼翼地將巨蟒從遊樂區中救出,而當一條捕雞巨蟒在緊張危急的救援過程中壓住莉芙的手時,更令人心跳加速,驚慌不已.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Respond to danger on a rural property with Mick and Adele, who brave a fired-up brown snake. Tread carefully as Jess and Dan extract a python from a play area, and get spooked when a chicken-hunting python squashes Livs hand during a tense rescue.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在繁殖季節中與米克和阿黛爾一起糾纏不清,他們救了一隻被饑餓的蟒蛇威脅的傑克羅素犬.與米克一起在泳池中對抗一條致命的紅腹黑蛇,並與斯圖和莉芙一起在建築工地上處理東部棕蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​準備好進行一場火熱的救援,當丹和傑絲從後院移除交配中的東部棕蛇時,然後屏住呼吸,因為米克在沙發墊裡嗅出了一條高度有毒的蛇.稍後,觀看斯圖拆解一個雞舍以撬出一條地毯蟒蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 急診室團隊正忙著應對春季患者潮.在救援隊抵禦粗魯的袋鼠時,獸醫菲爾 (Phil) 穩定了一隻小袋鼠.高級獸醫蒂姆 (Tim) 為一隻被貓抓傷的袋狸治療,並從柵欄捉出一隻魚遊蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scramble as the ER team tends to a spring flood of patients. Watch vet Phil stabilize an ailing joey as the rescue team fends off a rude kangaroo. Shadow senior vet Tim, who treats a cat-scratched bandicoot and snakes a keelback out of a grate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與救援人員喬 (Jo) 一同去撈起一隻吞下魚鉤的鵜鶘,隨後看到山姆 (Sam) 解救了一隻纏在柵欄里的蝙蝠幼崽.跟隨獸醫蒂姆,他救助一隻眼睛感染且脾氣怪戾的考拉,並觀看一條笨重的蟒蛇給新手魯比 (Ruby) 帶來的麻煩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head out with rescuer Jo to scoop up a pelican whos swallowed a fish hook, then see Sam free a newborn bat tangled in a fence. Follow vet Tim, who aids a surly koala with an eye infection, and watch a lumpy python give newbie Ruby a load of trouble.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 影子獸醫貝克 (Bec) 為被狗咬傷的考拉瑞秋 (Rachel) 包扎傷口,新手獸醫魯比 (Ruby) 和克里恩 (Kerryn) 負責安撫一群不安分的負鼠.與救援人員丹妮 (Dani) 一起解救一對被困在墻上的笑翠鳥,並觀看獸醫蒂姆 (Tim) 為松鼠袋鼯進行的膝蓋手術.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shadow vet Bec, who patches up dog-bitten koala Rachel, and new vets Ruby and Kerryn, who soothe a pack of itchy possums. Free a pair of kookaburras trapped in a wall with rescue officer Dani and watch vet Tims squirrel glider knee surgery.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​衝過昆士蘭東南地區,在繁殖與捕蛇的季節逐步升溫時,觀看阿黛兒與米克迎戰一條東部棕蛇,這是世界上第二致命的毒蛇,同時史都與麗芙則與一條地毯蟒糾纏搏鬥.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 急診室團隊正忙著應對春季患者潮.在救援隊抵禦粗魯的袋鼠時,獸醫菲爾 (Phil) 穩定了一隻小袋鼠.高級獸醫蒂姆 (Tim) 為一隻被貓抓傷的袋狸治療,並從柵欄捉出一隻魚遊蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scramble as the ER team tends to a spring flood of patients. Watch vet Phil stabilize an ailing joey as the rescue team fends off a rude kangaroo. Shadow senior vet Tim, who treats a cat-scratched bandicoot and snakes a keelback out of a grate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與救援人員喬 (Jo) 一同去撈起一隻吞下魚鉤的鵜鶘,隨後看到山姆 (Sam) 解救了一隻纏在柵欄里的蝙蝠幼崽.跟隨獸醫蒂姆,他救助一隻眼睛感染且脾氣怪戾的考拉,並觀看一條笨重的蟒蛇給新手魯比 (Ruby) 帶來的麻煩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head out with rescuer Jo to scoop up a pelican whos swallowed a fish hook, then see Sam free a newborn bat tangled in a fence. Follow vet Tim, who aids a surly koala with an eye infection, and watch a lumpy python give newbie Ruby a load of trouble.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 影子獸醫貝克 (Bec) 為被狗咬傷的考拉瑞秋 (Rachel) 包扎傷口,新手獸醫魯比 (Ruby) 和克里恩 (Kerryn) 負責安撫一群不安分的負鼠.與救援人員丹妮 (Dani) 一起解救一對被困在墻上的笑翠鳥,並觀看獸醫蒂姆 (Tim) 為松鼠袋鼯進行的膝蓋手術.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shadow vet Bec, who patches up dog-bitten koala Rachel, and new vets Ruby and Kerryn, who soothe a pack of itchy possums. Free a pair of kookaburras trapped in a wall with rescue officer Dani and watch vet Tims squirrel glider knee surgery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物界中一些最有趣的適應性是無形的.研究這些隱藏的內部變化,以觀察不同的動物如何用驚人且看不見的方式進化並生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some of the most interesting adaptations in the animal world are completely invisible. Study these hidden, internal alterations to see how different animals have evolved to survive in amazing and unseen ways.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​為家養驢凱許的生日慶祝,接著與臭鼬米爾頓玩捉迷藏.認識海狸比約納,他有一份非常重要的工作,並與樹袋鼠班特利及他的人類媽媽一起探索擁抱與午睡的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Celebrate Cash the house donkeys birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中.與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 對獅子來說,水牛固然是令人滿足的晚餐,但同時也是危險的獵物.與穆瓦姆巴獅群一起追蹤為數近三百頭水牛,並從中窺探他們的獵食技巧,他們必須迅速而謹慎地行動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To the lion, the buffalo is not only a satisfying dinner but also dangerous. Track a herd of 300 buffalo along with the Mwamba pride, who must act quickly and carefully if they are to take down their prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象傳奇有三個故事.一頭牛犢穿越奧卡萬戈三角洲.一頭公牛正尋覓伴侶.一位女族長帶領家人穿過沙漠.這些個別的冒險故事一同敍述了非洲最具標誌性物種之一的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​來認識「濱水」獅群的成員吧:雄獅湯姆・湯姆與卡勒,八隻雌獅,十頭年輕的獅子,以及愛因斯坦,那頭從未離開家園,如今已長成的幼獅.當愛因斯坦的反叛之舉逐漸發酵,最終在「外來者」獅群的對手發動攻勢時,為他釘下了命運的定局.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get to know the Waterfront Pride: males Tom Tom and Caller, 8 lionesses, 10 youths, and Einstein, the grown cub who never left home. Watch Einsteins defiance catch up with him when rivals from the Outsiders Pride make a play that seals his fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退潮時露出一條稱為潮間帶的海岸.這是一個令人驚愕的極端之地,受到熱帶氣旋 風浪的衝擊,又暴露在酷熱中.這裡的生物以無數怪異的方式進化. 科學家們探索這個外星之境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. Its a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​衝進嶄新的郊區社區,馴蛇專家努力阻止致命毒蛇滑入普通家庭住宅.觀看斯圖與莉芙將一條東方褐蛇從工地移出,傑絲與丹將巨蟒從倉庫中驅逐出去,而米克與阿黛爾則將紅腹蛇趕出臥室,確保屋主生活區域的安全.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Storm into a new suburb, where the wranglers keep deadly snakes from slipping into family homes. Watch as Stu and Liv pull an eastern brown from a job site, Jess and Dan expel a python from a shed, and Mick and Adele evict a red belly from a bedroom.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在偏遠農村地產面對危險時,米克與阿黛爾勇敢無畏地應對一條激烈攻擊的褐蛇.傑絲與丹小心翼翼地將巨蟒從遊樂區中救出,而當一條捕雞巨蟒在緊張危急的救援過程中壓住莉芙的手時,更令人心跳加速,驚慌不已.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Respond to danger on a rural property with Mick and Adele, who brave a fired-up brown snake. Tread carefully as Jess and Dan extract a python from a play area, and get spooked when a chicken-hunting python squashes Livs hand during a tense rescue.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Why do zebras have stripes? How do penguins see underwater? And why are a tree frogs eyes red? In this exploration of sight, discover how some animals have evolved to see extremely well while others have evolved to be nearly invisible.
